title: Uber reports Q2 revenue up 12% YoY to $14.2B, below $14.24B est., Gross Bookings up 24% to $58B, above $57B est., and forecasts Q3 adjusted EPS below est. (Lora Kolodny/CNBC)
summary: Lora Kolodny / CNBC: Uber reports Q2 revenue up 12% YoY to $14.2B, below $14.24B est., Gross Bookings up 24% to $58B, above $57B est., and forecasts Q3 adjusted EPS below est. — Uber issued a forecast for bookings and earnings that trailed analysts' estimates, while second-quarter profit was in line with expectations.
